jobs.title: Salesforce CRM Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job ID: 529805

CRH is a leading global diversified building materials group, employing over 75,800 people at more than 3,160 locations in 29 countries. CRH is the leading building materials company in North America and the world. We manufacture and distribute a diverse range of superior building materials, products, and solutions, which are used extensively in construction projects of all sizes.

Job Summary

Are you ready to be part of a growing organization where project management is a valued part of the business process, where you will be partnering with senior leaders to drive transformation that is implementing Salesforce? The role of Project Manager is an exciting opportunity to partner with leaders and drive value creation as we implement Organizational Change. This role is empowered to coordinate with business leaders, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and vendors to drive the project forward and deliver solutions enabled by process, people, and technology. This individual will ensure that all solutions adhere to organizational standards, controls, and best practices for operational readiness.

Job Location

This is a remote position, but candidates must be located in the state of Georgia within driving distance to the corporate office in the Perimeter area of Atlanta.

Job Responsibilities

Project management of large Salesforce software implementations
Develop and manage the project from beginning to end, including project scope, timeline (project plan), procurement of hardware and software, resourcing, and project execution
Drive execution of the project and ensure deliverables meet expectations in terms of quality, accuracy, and completeness
Drive change management across multiple business units with strong interpersonal skills; ability to work with people, environments, cultures
Measure, monitor, and maintain the internal and external vendor teams’ ability to meet or exceed KPIs
Create and socialize project-specific scorecards that drive profitable action
Actively manage project RIDAC (risks, issues, decisions, actions, changes) with a focus on adequately identifying, logging, and actioning completely, developing mitigation plans, and undertaking proactive actions to achieve a green status throughout the project
Proactively manage project change control, communicating any impact on project scope, identifying risks or issues, and devising contingency plans
Attend meetings as an effective representative when key group/member may not be able to attend, managing required follow-up, actions, and handoffs
Identify and manage project dependencies and critical paths while maintaining accurate project plans with real-time milestones, tasks, and project health data for your portfolio in the project management tool. This project may have multiple project plans representing the scope of various departments/teams working on project components
Apply organizational awareness to navigate the interdependencies between groups in both IT and the business, ensuring that the right resources are engaged in the right work at the right time
Provide input on the tactical needs of the organization based on engagement with stakeholders
Own updates and knowledge documentation to drive standardization. Ensure appropriate documentation artifacts are created through all phases of the project lifecycle to support the work of the project team, the impacted end users, project audits, and/or financial audits
Identify opportunities to streamline and/or enhance project components such as implementations, sharing best practices with your peers and leaders, and regularly implementing continuous improvement actions
Project implementation operational readiness - preparation and documentation before launch and ultimately project completion; all stakeholder, department, and support team confirmation prior to project closure

Job Requirements

5+ years of experience managing large software projects preferably Salesforce or a comparable CRM application
Hands-on experience with the implementation of Salesforce
Experience managing 3rd party vendors or consultants
Knowledge of CRM/ERP systems to drive organizational change
Business, financial, and IT acumen
Strong oral and written communication, including presentation skills
Team Leadership
Global business acumen
Emotional Intelligence establishing trusted relationships
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills
Hands-on experience in one or more project management software packages – SmartSheet, MS Project, ServiceNow, Jira, etc.
Experience working for a global manufacturing organization preferred
Large project expertise: $3M+, 6mo+, cross-functional team
Project delivery best practice knowledge
Strong knowledge of MS products –Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams, SharePoint, SmartSheet
Travel: 15% (or more as required by business and project needs)
May need to attend in person meetings in designated company locations
PMP certification preferred
Salesforce Specialist certification preferred
Salesforce Sales Cloud/Manufacturing Cloud, Six Sigma, Lean, PMP, and/or SAFe certifications preferred

Compensation

Base Salary - $100,000 - $120,000 per year
401k plan
Short-Term/Long-Term Disability
Life Insurance
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
Paid holidays
Opportunity for annual bonus

What CRH Offers You

Highly competitive base pay
Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
Group retirement savings program
Health and wellness programs
An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

About CRH

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

CRH is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

EOE/Vet/Disability

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Senior IT Project Manager at BairesDev

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will oversee and coordinate complex IT projects to ensure they are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational standards. You will guide multi-functional technical teams and streamline engineering workflows, fostering a highly collaborative environment that drives successful technical execution.

What You'll Do:

- Plan, monitor, and drive the execution of IT and software projects from initial concept through completion.
- Coordinate and manage multi-disciplinary engineering teams, providing clear direction and professional guidance.
- Align technical project delivery with broader business strategies and stakeholder expectations.
- Monitor project capacity, resource allocation, and budget performance to optimize efficiency and profitability.
- Enforce project management methodologies, processes, and policies to ensure consistent, high-quality deliverables.

What we are looking for:

- 5+ years of experience as an IT Project Manager.
- Proven experience in the IT industry managing technical projects.
- Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
- Advanced proficiency in English.

How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

- 100% remote work (from anywhere).
- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.
- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.description:
Join the MEPPI Team!

Mitsubishi Electric Power Products, Inc. (MEPPI) is seeking a Project Manager II
role to work within our Diamon Vision Division. This role is remote with extensive travel.

What You’ll Do

Direct and supervise on-site construction and subcontractors for installation and service activities for DVD.
Manage sales and maintenance service projects to assure on-time completion within established budgets.
Coordinate and support the fulfillment of event support and other maintenance service obligations.
Collaborate with customers, subcontractors, architects and consultants to coordinate project requirements.
Oversee creation of system documentation for customers including as-built documents and operation manuals.
Ensure all aspects of project scope including subcontractors’ work conform to all applicable contracts.
Prepare and review subcontractor and customer price quotations to maximize profit in a fair and equitable way.
Write subcontractor scopes of work for installation and maintenance services.
Coordinate procurement, delivery, installation and servicing activities of video equipment systems.
Assist Display Systems Engineer with testing and quality control of video display system prior to final acceptance and during service activities.
Coordinate all required details for project scheduling, closeout and warranty/service obligations.
Manage safety and insurance issues on assigned projects.
Prepare project activity reports and hold project meetings with subcontractors/crew supervisors as directed.
Review requests for payment associated with projects.
Prepare project status reports and keep management, customers and stakeholders informed of project status and related issues when required.
Further the goals and positive, professional image of the DVD Division by effective dealings with customers and other internal departments.
Know MEPPI’s Quality, Safety and Environmental Policies. Be able to fully discuss the importance of these policies and how they impact work.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Construction Management, Construction Engineering or related field with a minimum 2 years of experience working on construction projects, or equivalent education and experience.
Advanced knowledge of project management and/or commercial construction concepts.
Intermediate knowledge of electrical systems, power control and video systems.
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills required to communicate with employees, vendors and customers.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings and material.
Advance computer skills with emphasis on Microsoft Office applications including Project.

What’s In It For You

Comprehensive Health Coverage:
Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans with low employee premiums.

Retirement Plans:
401(k) match of up to 4%.

Generous Paid Time Off:
Earn vacation after just 90 days, plus enjoy 12 paid holidays annually.

Career Growth:
Access to professional development programs and educational assistance.

Employee Perks:
On-site fitness center (Warrendale, PA), wellness program, profit sharing, and employee discounts.

Why MEPPI

As a proud U.S. affiliate of Mitsubishi Electric, MEPPI powers critical infrastructure and rail transportation solutions across North America. We value collaboration, innovation, and people—because we know that our greatest asset is our team. Join us and help shape a future where talent and technology thrive.

Equal Opportunity Employer

MEPPI is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and ensure fair consideration for every candidate.

Notice To Agencies And Search Firms

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Submissions without signed agreements become the property of MEPPI, and no fees will be paid.

jobs.description:
What you'll find in this role

A sixty-person ed-tech company selling to schools and colleges is hiring its first dedicated project manager. Product, content, sales and customer success all run their own projects today, and school onboarding season is when the gaps show. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps companies hire experienced professionals, and it is running this search.
What you would own

School and college onboarding projects, from signed contract to first live class
The cross-team release calendar, so that product changes do not land in the middle of an exam week
Content production schedules, working with curriculum writers and designers
A single weekly view of every open project, its owner, its next date and its risk

You will run short stand-ups with each team, keep project plans in a tool people actually open, and step in when a deadline is at risk. You will also run a retrospective after each admissions cycle and turn what you learn into a checklist the next cycle uses.

3 to 7 years managing projects with several teams, ideally in a software or services company
Comfort with Jira, Asana, Notion or similar, and willingness to choose one and stick to it
Clear and brief written updates, and a habit of asking one useful question before offering an opinion
Patience with school administrators and the calendar they work to

Working arrangement

Location:
Remote (India)
What happens next

A short call with a Flexiple recruiter, a project walkthrough with the head of operations, a conversation with a product lead and a closing chat with a founder. We will keep your single application on file for future roles that match.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Enterprise Merchandise
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Project Manager - Enterprise Merchandise

As a Project Manager, you will be the operational backbone of our enterprise sales process. You will partner directly with Account Executives to manage the complete order-to-delivery lifecycle for clients, ensuring flawless execution and exceptional customer experience. Working alongside the sales team, you will leverage deep product knowledge and operational excellence to support deal closure and drive client satisfaction. Your role is critical to scaling our enterprise business while maintaining the quality and attention to detail that defines Quince.

Responsibilities

Assume deal ownership post-sale, from logo approval through invoicing, delivery and issue resolution
Track and update all project progress in our B2B operations tracker, sharing timely updates with clients and Account Executives; communicate with clarity even when information is incomplete or ambiguous
Finalize customization details, communicate delivery timelines, and manage approval workflows with clients and internal teams
Field and resolve client support requests including sample returns, shipping and tracking, troubleshooting missing or damaged items, and expediting requests when possible
Demonstrate strategic thinking by proactively identifying opportunities to streamline operations, reduce tasks, and propose solutions that enhance client experience
Over-communicate with customers on all issues, managing them with confidence and compassion; reply to requests with urgency and follow through on every commitment made

Qualifications

Required:

1+ years of experience in project management, operations, or vendor management
Familiarity with CRM or project management platforms to track client data, order status, and communication history (Hubspot preferred)
Proficiency in Google Workspace
Experience managing internal and external stakeholders with distinct approaches
Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Extremely detail-oriented with ability to operate with a sense of urgency
Customer service oriented and customer obsessed—committed to exceeding expectations at every touchpoint

Preferred:

Customer experience or customer-facing background (email-based support, retail customer service, or account coordination)
Exposure to apparel, decoration, manufacturing, or promotional products industry

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: $62,500 USD - $75,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Regional Project Manager (Construction)
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

This organization operates in the healthcare services sector, focusing on improving safety and accessibility in homes for older adults and high-needs populations. It addresses challenges related to maintaining independence and reducing health risks at home by integrating technology with a network of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications across the nation. The company is experiencing rapid growth and has support from established venture capital firms.

About the Opportunity:

The REGIONAL PROJECT MANAGER (CONSTRUCTION) role is designed to manage home modification projects within a specific region, ensuring high-quality installation and client satisfaction. This position plays a critical part in expanding and maintaining a network of service providers and directly impacts the well-being and independence of vulnerable populations by overseeing projects that enhance home safety and accessibility.

Responsibilities:

Manage end-to-end home modification installation projects
Coordinate communication among clinical teams, clients, families, and service providers
Deliver projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality standards
Recruit, onboard, and develop regional service provider networks
Establish and enforce quality standards across contractors
Conduct performance reviews and provide ongoing training
Perform on-site quality inspections and assessments
Implement corrective actions for non-compliant installations
Handle escalations for complex technical or client issues

Requirements:

Minimum 3 years of construction field experience, preferably residential
At least 5 years in residential management roles
Preferably experienced in home modifications such as bathrooms and ramps

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Compensation Range: $80,000-$90,000 per year plus company equity

Benefits & Perks:

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: St. Paul MN

Duration: 12-15 Months

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a countywide migration of enterprise storage and on-premises hosted applications to cloud platforms. This role will coordinate business and technical teams across more than 3,500 users and 60 locations, guiding the initiative from planning and readiness through controlled migration and operational transition.
The successful consultant will combine hands-on infrastructure delivery leadership with strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and awareness of government operations. The role requires the ability to manage technology, process, and people impacts while maintaining clear governance, disciplined execution, and minimal disruption to county services.
Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Governance

Own project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, dependencies, and deliverables across the full migration lifecycle.
Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestones, governance cadence, RAID Log, and executive reporting.
Partner with sponsors, senior business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and departmental stakeholders to align objectives, priorities, and success criteria.
Drive risks, actions, issues, and decisions to timely resolution; assess impacts and recommend practical corrective options.
Provide clear, decision-ready status communications for executive, business, and technical audiences.

Migration Planning and Delivery

Lead discovery, inventory, assessment, sequencing, readiness, migration-wave planning, testing, cutover, validation, and transition activities.
Coordinate migration of personal home drives and departmental file shares to approved cloud storage platforms.
Coordinate migration of on-premises hosted applications, including dependencies, integration needs, technical readiness, and business validation.
Plan and oversee controlled migration events, including after-hours activities when required, to minimize operational disruption.
Define acceptance criteria and ensure quality, security, compliance, support, and operational-readiness requirements are met before transition.

Change Enablement and Vendor Coordination

Lead stakeholder communications, training coordination, adoption planning, and organizational change activities across affected departments and locations.
Coordinate procurement and vendor activities, including deliverables, schedules, dependencies, performance, and issue escalation.
Facilitate cross-functional workshops, working sessions, readiness reviews, and post-migration retrospectives.
Support knowledge transfer and handoff to operational teams, with complete project records and support documentation.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of experience supporting IS/IT infrastructure or security engagements in a Project Manager or Business Analyst role.
Demonstrated experience delivering technology initiatives that include technology, process, and people components.
Experience leading full-lifecycle technology delivery from planning through implementation and transition.
Proven ability to work directly with senior business leaders, technical specialists, vendors, and end-user staff.
Strong cross-functional collaboration, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication, including executive-level reporting and presentations.
Intermediate or higher proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project documentation tools.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year institution; or an associate degree plus five additional years of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering projects for state, county, or city government.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP).
Working knowledge of ITIL practices.
Experience with enterprise cloud storage migrations, application migrations, infrastructure modernization, or related security and compliance requirements.

Engagement Details

Work arrangement:
Hybrid, with a minimum of two days onsite each week in St. Paul.
Commitment:
40 hours per week.

12–15 months.

Position Purpose

The Project Manager Senior is responsible for simultaneously directing the efforts of multiple cross-functional project teams to achieve clearly defined results within the triple constraints of time, budget and specifications for medium and high-complexity projects. This position is responsible for an average of 3-6 projects as well as low-complexity programs. The position is responsible for assembling the project team, developing the project work plan, and managing the expectations, deliverables and results of all internal and external project resources for the roles and activities defined in the plan. This includes managing outside vendors to ensure they meet contractual deliverables. The Project Manager is responsible for tracking project milestones and making necessary adjustments to the project plan or resources to maintain customer commitments. The Project Manager communicates project status and risks to all project stakeholders via standardized project status reports and manages the change process for each assigned project.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities

Manages three or more medium- to large-scale projects from planning to completion by facilitating meetings with project stakeholders. Develops, analyzes, and manages project estimation and execution plans, schedules, and resource forecasts. Manages project financials and provides input and justification for costs and budget impacts. Monitors overall project performance against plan and makes adjustments as needed. Identifies and resolves issues. Provides insight and direction for the request for information and vendor request for proposal processes.
Manages the work of multiple project teams by recommending or requesting resources based on the alignment of team member skills and project demands. Communicates a clear vision of project goals and objectives to the team. Coordinates team activities to ensure project milestones are achieved. Lead and provide work direction to a project team to determine project scope, devise and maintain a workable plan, and to develop and deploy the solution in accordance with the needs of the project. Provides performance feedback to team members as needed.
Manages, controls, and mitigates risks across multiple projects by analyzing and identifying trigger events. Manage the project change control process, status reporting, project estimating, monthly cost accounting and vendor invoice processing. Establishes contingency plans, anticipates and manages dependencies affected by ongoing changes across projects, and recommends ways to mitigate future risks. Influences management to take action on these recommendations.
Manages the alignment, buy-in, and support of diverse project stakeholders by building and maintaining relationships with internal customers, third party vendors, and senior management. Manage interaction between the customer, vendors, and the internal project team to ensure that appropriate relationships exist to produce positive project outcomes. Provides insight and recommendations to Program Managers to drive the development of project goals, influence the prioritization of deliverables, and facilitate decisions necessary for project delivery.
Adheres to enterprise project management practices by participating in formal and informal training sessions. Tracks and reports key metrics as needed. Gathers, maintains, and communicates lessons learned and feedback to team members, management, and the larger project management community.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
6+ years of project management experience, including 8+ years of IT or related business experience.
3 to 5 years of experience working on projects involving the implementation of project life cycle methodologies.
Experience influencing and managing project teams without formal direct reporting relationships.
Experience managing SDLC projects using an iterative methodology preferred.
Comprehensive knowledge of PMI based project management competency areas and methodologies and experience applying these methods to manage successful projects.
Analytical skills are required to effectively manage activities related to budgeting, forecasting, monitoring, process management, risk management, quality control and reporting.
Strong oral and written communication skills and experience leveraging these skills to interact with all levels of management.
Strong negotiation and influencing skills.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Logistics Control Tower & Analytics – Data Center Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.
Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.
SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.
Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!
Basic Function

As a member of the Data Center Supply Chain team, the Senior Program Manager, Logistics Control Tower & Analytics will own supplier logistics readiness and run the dedicated Control Tower provider/team supporting domestic OFCI execution. The role maintains live portfolio data, daily operating reviews, exceptions and action closure, performance reporting and business requirements for logistics tools. The Control Tower coordinates their readiness and agreed handoff evidence. The shared Supply Chain Governance and Assurance function owns the common framework; IT owns technical delivery and service.
SB Energy is building a procurement team under a common role profile, bringing together complementary electrical, mechanical, commercial, and logistics strengths. Within this team, this role focuses on logistics control tower operations, including shipment and milestone visibility, data quality, exception management, and performance reporting. The manager may lead control tower activities for an individual project, manage logistics visibility and reporting across multiple projects, or lead a shared logistics analytics or process improvement assignment.
Assignments may evolve as projects advance, workloads shift, and business priorities change. The manager is expected to contribute beyond their primary area, including broader procurement, sourcing, supplier development, or planning assignments, based on relevant experience, equipment knowledge, readiness, workload, and appropriate specialist support. Each manager maintains clear ownership of assigned responsibilities, cross-trains colleagues, and provides structured handoffs and backup coverage.
Candidates must demonstrate depth in logistics control tower operations, data analysis, and exception management, together with the flexibility and willingness to build capability across the broader function. Candidates are not expected to be specialists in every electrical, mechanical, commercial, or logistics discipline.

Responsibilities

Portfolio and Supplier Readiness:
Maintain one reconciled OFCI register linking projects, equipment, POs, OEM readiness, agreed handoffs, domestic shipments, storage, custody, costs and exceptions. Track shipping-data completeness, cargo-ready commitments, packaging/preservation evidence and open readiness actions with OEMs. Procurement retains manufacturing/commercial expediting; Engineering/Quality retains technical release. Preserve required/baseline, planned, forecast, committed and actual dates and the data date.
Daily Operating Reviews:
Direct the dedicated Control Tower team’s daily readiness, exception and action-closure work. Make risks to Required on Site Dates visible, secure accountable owners and escalate recovery decisions. Transportation authorizes domestic dispatch; Storage/Site owns inventory and preservation controls; designated functions retain their approvals.
Decision and Delivery Tracking:
Maintain operating decision, action, risk, dependency, and change logs. Track the implementation plan across staffing, providers, contracts, processes, data, and training. Escalate overdue decisions, unassigned work, and resource gaps with a recommendation and decision deadline.
Business Product Ownership:
Define operating requirements, prioritize the backlog, and lead user acceptance testing and adoption for the OFCI Logistics Control Hub or approved equivalent. Start with available tools and practical controls; agree build, release, support, and service ownership with designated Analytics and IT teams.
Data and Reporting:
Define logistics KPI logic, source lineage, data-quality checks, dashboards, and executive decision views with capability owners and Finance. Reconcile incomplete or conflicting records, assign corrections to source owners, and keep material uncertainty visible. Validate technical deliverables against business requirements.
Provider Performance:
Own the dedicated Control Tower provider/team’s scope, staffing, coverage, service levels, data quality, operational reviews and corrective actions. Require OEM-readiness and end-to-end logistics experience, evidence access and export rights. Support transport and warehouse leads with common reporting; their respective providers retain contracted execution obligations.
Governance and Assurance Interface:
Apply common process, documentation, control, and evidence standards set with the shared Supply Chain Governance and Assurance function. Supply authoritative OFCI records for its reviews, coordinate operational corrective actions, and escalate recurring control weaknesses without creating duplicate trackers.
Adoption and Improvement:
Lead OFCI-specific user guidance, training, release communications, and workflow improvements. Coordinate changes to common standards with Governance and Assurance and obtain functional approval for release-criteria changes. Prioritize automation against data readiness, approved technical design, and funded capacity.

Qualifications/Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering, information systems, construction management, analytics, or a related field.
At least 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years leading complex cross-functional programs, logistics control towers, or operating-model implementation in supply chain, infrastructure, construction, manufacturing, or a comparable environment.
Demonstrated experience leading supplier logistics readiness and a dedicated Control Tower team, with milestone models, readiness gates, exception resolution, action closure and operating reviews that improve execution.
Hands-on ability to structure and reconcile operational data in Excel or comparable tools, define KPIs and data-quality controls, and turn incomplete information into useful decision views.
Experience translating business needs into requirements, prioritized backlogs, acceptance criteria, user testing, deployment, and adoption with analysts and IT.
Strong executive writing, facilitation, and matrix leadership; ability to secure clear ownership and drive action while live operations continue.

Preferred Qualifications

Data center, cloud infrastructure, power, energy, EPC, industrial, or comparable large capital-program experience.
Experience with logistics platforms, provider data, Power BI, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, or comparable analytics and workflow tools.
Experience with provider-team mobilization and performance, OEM readiness and handoff control, cost/benefits tracking and change adoption; relevant program-management or product-owner certification.

Working arrangements
Assignments may span projects, equipment categories, suppliers, and locations and may change with business needs. The role includes supplier, factory, warehouse, and active construction site visits, coordination across time zones, and compliance with site safety and access requirements. Managers lead execution through qualified suppliers and project resources.  
Location: 
Redwood City, CA; San Diego, CA; Phoenix, AZ; Austin, TX
US remote locations considered on a case by case basis.
This role leads programs and business product delivery across distributed teams, providers, and time zones, with visits to project sites and implementation sessions. Designated technical teams own application engineering, integrations, architecture, security, administration, and ongoing technical service.
Base Pay - $160,000 - $200,000
The pay range mentioned above is a guideline. We tailor each offer based on your unique skills, experience, location, and market benchmarks—while ensuring internal parity across our teams. The compensation range provided reflects base pay. Total rewards may also include performance-based bonuses, equity grants, and a market leading comprehensive health and wellness benefits package. Final details will be discussed during the later stages of the hiring process.
Our Health & Wellness Benefits

At SB Energy, we invest in our people and their families with benefits designed for flexibility, support, and peace of mind. Full-time employees enjoy:
100% Company-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision (for employees and dependents)
401(k) with Company Match
Generous Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Holidays
12 Weeks Parental Leave
Life, AD&D & Long-Term Disability Coverage
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for Medical, Dependent Care, Transit & Parking (with company contributions)
Mental, Physical & Social Wellness Support (with company contributions)
Flexible Work Arrangements & Hybrid Office Setup Benefits
Monthly Reimbursement for Phone, Internet & Data
Optional Legal & Pet Insurance Plans
Device Purchase Support

At SB Energy, the success of our projects is driven by a desire to see our projects benefit as many people as possible. We work to serve local communities through volunteering, fundraising, and much more. For example, we’re proud to support access and opportunity in engineering and clean energy through impactful mentorship programs and workforce training. When you join SB Energy, you can become a part of these efforts, collaborating with team members who share a vision of building a better future now! 
SB Energy is built on a foundation of collaboration and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.
To learn more about us, visit www.sbenergy.com.

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.

We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll partner closely with Recruiters, Recruiting Operations, People Operations, and senior leadership to drive some of our highest-priority initiatives — building the programs and processes that define how Notion finds, evaluates, and brings in exceptional talent.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

The scope of this role will evolve with the team's highest priorities. Some examples of what you might work on:

Interviewer systems and efficacy — design the systems, structures, and standards that make Notion's interviewing reliably great: how we train interviewers, how we measure their effectiveness, how we calibrate quality over time, and how we continuously raise the bar; this includes programs like Interviewer 101, Hiring Manager Training, and functional interviewer certifications tailored to specific teams
Interviewer pool health — own the systems and strategy behind how we maintain a healthy, well-mapped interviewer pool, manage AI and experimental interview formats, and keep quality high at scale
Recruiting team onboarding and enablement — build and run programs that get new recruiters up to speed quickly and keep the team operating at a high level
Specialty hiring programs — provide program management support for specialized hiring motions like internal mobility, M&A integration, and other high-priority strategic initiatives
Cross-functional playbooks and infrastructure — build the processes, communications, and coordination frameworks that help Recruiting run with more consistency, clarity, and scale

Skills You'll Need to Bring

5+ years of relevant experience in program management, recruiting operations, or a highly cross-functional role in a fast-moving environment
High agency — you move fast, take ownership end-to-end, and don't wait for perfect information or explicit direction to get started. Ambiguity doesn't scare you.
Builder mentality — you're most energized when creating something new or improving something that doesn't yet work well
Strong AI skills — think beyond generative AI. We're looking for folks with hands-on experience building custom agents, skills, etc and have taught them to others. You're genuinely excited about using AI to change how a core business function works
Strong project management skills — you can lead complex initiatives from scoping through execution, managing stakeholders, timelines, and competing priorities along the way; you're equally comfortable driving short-term sprints and stewarding long-range programs that evolve over months or years
Proven ability to operate with discretion and high judgment on sensitive or high-profile work
Strong analytical instincts — you use data to evaluate program health, spot patterns, and make informed decisions
Outstanding written and verbal communication — you tailor your message to the audience and create clarity across all levels of the organization

Nice to Haves

Experience with recruiting program management workstreams through different stages of recruiting evolution
You use Notion and love it — you get what we're building

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $195,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact

AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.
Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.

The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.
The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.
Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.
White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce.

TruVs.com is a leading business process and technology consulting firm headquartered in the Seattle Metro area, with a presence across North America and Asia. We specialize in modernizing business operations and IT systems using innovative solutions and advanced technologies. Our expertise spans Business Process Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Modernization, Infrastructure Modernization, Business Testing, and Compliance. Serving primarily Fortune 500 technology enterprises, we are dedicated to driving exceptional results and growth for our clients.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will play a critical role in supporting enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure capacity planning and resource optimization initiatives.
You will collaborate with engineering, operations, product, and business stakeholders to translate capacity demands into actionable plans, manage technical execution, prioritize workstreams, and ensure timely delivery of key business outcomes.
This is a hands-on delivery role that requires a combination of technical understanding, business judgment, structured execution, analytical thinking, and exceptional stakeholder communication.
The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing multiple priorities, and independently driving results in a highly collaborative enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Capacity Planning & Demand Management

Support development and ongoing management of cloud infrastructure demand plans, resource forecasts, and capacity planning initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand demand drivers, growth projections, infrastructure constraints, and operational priorities.
Support demand intake, triage, prioritization, and execution tracking.
Identify opportunities to improve resource utilization, planning efficiency, and operational performance.

2. Technical Program & Agile Delivery Management

Own and coordinate the execution of assigned technical programs, product initiatives, and workstreams.
Translate business objectives into detailed requirements, user stories, delivery plans, and actionable engineering backlogs.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and work-item prioritization.
Track dependencies, milestones, risks, blockers, and critical action items.
Coordinate release activities, change requests, production issue resolution, and bug-fix prioritization.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical implementation.

3. Product Planning & Execution

Contribute to strategic roadmaps for capacity planning and resource optimization capabilities.
Define product requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria in partnership with business and engineering stakeholders.
Balance immediate operational priorities with medium- and longer-term modernization objectives.
Support continuous improvement in planning processes, tools, and operational workflows.

4. Data Analytics & Operational Performance

Analyze planning, demand, capacity, and operational data to generate actionable insights.
Define, track, and communicate meaningful operational KPIs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries using Excel, Power BI, or other approved enterprise tools.
Support ad hoc analytical requests and data-driven business decisions.
Identify inefficiencies, process bottlenecks, and opportunities for measurable improvement.

5. Stakeholder & Executive Communication

Work directly with senior business leaders, engineering teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Facilitate weekly status meetings and coordinate follow-up actions.
Prepare concise executive-level status reports, business review presentations, and steering committee materials.
Communicate program progress, delivery risks, critical dependencies, and escalation items.
Drive alignment across teams with competing objectives and priorities.

6. Governance, Quality & Compliance

Maintain accurate project documentation, including risk and issue registers, action-item trackers, dependency logs, status reports, and meeting summaries.
Support timely, complete, and high-quality monthly deliverables.
Follow enterprise information security, data privacy, confidentiality, and access-control requirements.
Use only client-approved systems and tools for client-related work.
Ensure appropriate engineering review and approvals before introducing or operationalizing technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably including at least 4 years in technical program management, technical product management, or related enterprise delivery roles.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, backlog management, and technical delivery lifecycles.
Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management platforms.
Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to translate complex business needs into clear requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
Experience developing executive reporting materials and communicating with senior stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with geographically distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with Microsoft or another major cloud technology provider.
Familiarity with Azure infrastructure, cloud capacity planning, infrastructure provisioning, or cloud supply chain operations.
Experience with demand forecasting, resource planning, capacity optimization, or infrastructure operations.
Strong working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365.
Experience in enterprise product management, release management, or operational program management.
Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, reporting automation, or business intelligence.
Certifications such as PMP, CSM, CSPO, SAFe, or relevant Microsoft certifications.
Experience working in a consulting or client-facing delivery environment.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 60–90 days, the successful candidate should be able to:

Independently manage assigned workstreams with clearly defined priorities, milestones, and execution plans.
Build effective working relationships with business, product, and engineering stakeholders.
Maintain reliable delivery tracking, risk management, and dependency reporting.
Deliver accurate, actionable, and executive-ready status updates.
Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery visibility, stakeholder coordination, or operational efficiency.
Consistently produce high-quality work products with minimal supervision.

Please submit your resume with a brief summary of your experience in technical program management, cloud infrastructure, capacity planning, or enterprise technology delivery to careers@truvs.com

The United States Space Command (USSPACECOM) in Colorado Springs, CO conducts operations in, from, and to space to deter conflict, defeat aggression, deliver space combat power for the Joint/Combined force, and defend U.S. vital interests with allies and partners. We are searching for an exceptional leader and subject matter expert to serve as the Supervisory Management and Program Analyst for the Commercial and Technology Integration Branch within the J81 Division. Come join our mission-driven team ensuring there is never a day without space!

There’s a reason Colorado Springs has consistently ranked among the top U.S. cities to live. Nestled at the foot of Pikes Peak, the region offers breathtaking mountain scenery, world-class outdoor recreation, an expanding innovation economy, top-rated school systems, and diverse cultural and family attractions.

Description of Position:
Serves as Branch Chief exercising first-level supervisory and managerial authorities over the Commercial and Technology Integration Branch. The incumbent oversees the planning, organization, capability integration, and determination of necessary policies, directives, doctrine, and procedures for USSPACECOM program areas. The Branch Chief leads the integration of commercial solutions, emerging technologies, and advanced programmatic architectures into USSPACECOM’s offensive and defensive space capabilities. This role drives cradle-to-grave advocacy through the Joint Force Requirements Process (JFRP)

Position Responsibilities:

Exercises first-level supervisory authorities over civilian, military, and contractor personnel. Plans work to be accomplished by subordinates, sets and adjusts short- and long-term priorities, and prepares schedules for completion of work.
Plans, organizes, and directs requirements and capability development for USSPACECOM and joint forces, ensuring strict alignment with legal, regulatory, and fiscal accountability mandates.
Develops goals and objectives that integrate commercial and emerging space technology with Combatant Command operational mission areas, adhering to CCMD instructions, DoW regulations, JFRP, and requirements management practices.
Advocates for capabilities and resources outlined in the Unified Command Plan (UCP); synthesizes future capability requirements, resourcing strategies, and prioritization recommendations for USSPACECOM HQ leadership to support the full spectrum of security concerns presented to the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (CJCS) and partner agencies.
Directly advises the Commander, USSPACECOM, and senior executive leadership with authoritative technical and programmatic expertise regarding commercial and technology integration.
Spearheads development of key JCIDS documents, including Initial Capabilities Documents (ICD), Capability Development Documents (CDD), and related capability assessments.
Assesses space superiority, protection, and defense requirements across space architectures, Space Command and Control (C2), Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications (NC3), Data Transport and Relay Networks (DTRN), and advanced data capabilities.
Interacts directly with defense industry leaders, commercial space vendors, and military acquisition officials to translate mission operational needs into viable technological solutions and acquisition programs.
Directs research efforts and leads analytical study teams to evaluate issues, resolve operational shortfalls, and ensure alignment with national integrated deterrence goals.
Represents the Command at high-level executive working groups, capability boards, and defense forums to resolve complex or contentious program requirements and negotiate strategic capability priorities.

Desired Skills/Expertise:

In-depth, authoritative knowledge of the policies, principles, concepts, guidance, procedures, techniques, and methodologies pertaining to assigned commercial technology integration and space mission area capabilities.
Comprehensive knowledge of the mission, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operations of the Department of War, Space Force, Air Force, and Combatant Commands to provide executive-level staff guidance.
Expert knowledge of qualitative and quantitative methods for assessing and advancing command plans and programs across Orbital Warfare, Offensive/Defensive Space Control (OSC/DSC), Space Superiority Operations, Space Domain Awareness (SDA), Space C2, Electronic Warfare (EW), Cyber, PPBE, and defense acquisition systems.
Advanced skill in communicating complex technical, programmatic, and strategic concepts both orally and in writing; proven ability to negotiate high-stakes issues and build consensus among executive military leaders, interagency partners, and industry executives.
Proven ability to organize, lead, and direct multidisciplinary study teams and working groups tasked with originating innovative ideas, pioneering concepts, and cutting-edge operational methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, mentor, motivate, and direct a diverse workforce, appraise performance, and manage human capital effectively in a high-tempo joint command environment.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, plan, and adjust work operations across organizational segments to meet shifting program milestones and command priorities within available resource constraints.

Qualification Requirements:

Candidates must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the next lower broadband level (NH-III / GS-13) in the federal service. Specialized experience includes managing or leading programs involving space capabilities, developing JCIDS/PPBE documentation, formulating strategic capability requirements, or directing cross-functional technical teams.
Refer to the OPM Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Management and Program Analysis Series, 0343.

supervisionam a entrega de grandes projetos dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento. Você será a força motriz por trás de todos os aspectos do sucesso de um programa e o “regente” que orquestra os esforços de todos para criar um resultado harmonioso. Como o principal ponto de contato com o cliente, você também será a representação viva da reputação da Kyndryl todos os dias.

Como Gerente de Projetos, você terá controle de uma agenda muito cheia e orientada a detalhes. Você será responsável por elaborar planos de projeto detalhados, gerenciar equipes e conduzir reuniões, chamadas de status, planejamento e encontros periódicos. Você irá analisar e mitigar riscos, gerenciar finanças, garantir que a equipe tenha as competências certas, além de planejar e delegar atividades para cumprir prazos, atender SLAs e, de forma geral, encantar nossos clientes. Naturalmente, os planos evoluem à medida que o projeto avança, então será necessário praticar pensamento estruturado contínuo e assumir a responsabilidade pela entrega de valor — não apenas pelo cumprimento de tarefas.

Mas tão importante quanto o planejamento e a organização é a comunicação, que representa 90% do trabalho. Você será o ponto único de contato com o cliente, parceiros e todas as partes interessadas, apoiando-os e garantindo que recebam o que precisam. SAP Project Manager (PM)
SAP Project Manager (PM) is responsible for providing support to the IT group and overseeing the implementation of SAP projects. What you will do

Regulations & Standards: The PM must ensure that the project is compliant with all relevant SOX regulations and Change Management and Project Management policies.
Delivery: The PM is responsible for providing support to the Delivery team, including scheduling meetings, organizing community events, formatting, maintaining issue logs and risk registers, taking minutes, and reporting. They must ensure all information and documentation is processed, maintained, monitored, and filed.
Planning and Management: The PM is responsible for creating and maintaining a comprehensive project plan that outlines the project’s scope, schedule, budget, and resources required. They must also work with the project team to agree roles and responsibilities and create a communication plan that includes regular status updates and stakeholder engagement. jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst- OSINT Monitoring and Triage
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly capable Protective Intelligence Analyst to support the protection of senior Vanguard executives globally. This role requires an experienced OSINT practitioner who can independently manage threat identification and triage, prioritize competing executive protection needs, and produce decision-ready intelligence products under time pressure. The position owns the threat identification and initial assessment function for Vanguard’s protective intelligence program, including the daily monitoring and alert queue through which every inbound threat communication, platform alert, and referral receives its initial assessment. The Protective Intelligence Analyst will distinguish credible concerns from noise, open cases for identified security concerns, and manage case tracking and related metrics for the program. The role offers broad exposure across the protective intelligence lifecycle and meaningful ownership of threat intake, applying structured analytic judgment to determine which matters warrant escalation or further investigation.

Monitoring & Triage

Manage daily alert and intake queues: vendor alerting feeds, the program’s intake channels, executive-assistant and partner referrals, and regional intelligence routing.
Triage inbound items against the program’s established threat screening criteria; disposition items as unfounded with documented rationale or open cases for investigation.
Provide dedicated monitoring coverage during executive travel and event windows, assessing emerging developments in real time and escalating per defined criteria.
Maintain watchlist hygiene and help fine tune OSINT feeds to ensure reliable threat identification.

Case Management & Intelligence Production

Maintain key protective intelligence trackers/metrics: request log, alert log, case entries, product IDs, and dashboard integrity.
Conduct OSINT collection and analysis for protective intelligence assessments, documenting sources and findings and contributing analytic judgments to final products.
Draft the program’s weekly intelligence summary, synthesizing alert activity, case developments, and emerging threat trends into concise, decision-ready reporting.
Process intake acknowledgements and maintain records-handling standards for intake channels.

Team Model – Primary Focus, Universal Capability

Triage and monitoring is the primary focus of this role, not an exclusive lane. Every Protective Intelligence Analyst trains to produce the program’s core assessment products to standard, rotates through triage and monitoring coverage, and serves as designated backup for at least one other product line, so the team carries no single points of failure.
Cross-train teammates in triage and monitoring, maintain current proficiency in teammates’ specialties, and participate in the program’s dual-review and after-action practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, intelligence studies, security studies, psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Minimum of three years of related experience in a field such as intelligence analysis, GSOC/watch operations, journalism/research, or military/law-enforcement analysis.
Demonstrated ability to work a high-volume queue with consistency, accuracy, and documented decisions.
Strong OSINT skills, including the ability to locate, verify, and assess the credibility of information across open sources.
Comfort with reading concerning or threatening content professionally and escalating appropriately.
High ethical standards and discretion when handling sensitive executive and corporate information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders clearly and calmly under time pressure.
Proven ability to think critically and assess incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting information.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with threat intelligence, alerting, or case management platforms.
Formal training or applied experience in threat assessment, targeted violence prevention, or intelligence analysis.
ATAP membership, with active interest or progress toward obtaining the Certified Threat Manager (CTM) designation.

Special Factors

Participation in an on-call rotation for after-hours escalation support as the program matures.
Early-morning queue coverage; occasional evening and weekend surge coverage during executive travel windows.
Occasional domestic travel (

Special Factors

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Analyst, Oncology Diagnosis (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary

Generate actionable intelligence on the scientific, clinical, and competitive landscape for next-generation sequencing (NGS) and other molecular diagnostic tests used in oncology.
Apply scientific and clinical oncology expertise or in-depth oncology diagnostics market analysis experience to interpret evidence, assess product differentiation, and inform decisions across Commercial, Marketing, Medical Affairs, and R&D.

Job Responsibilities

Scientific and Clinical Analysis

Critically evaluate publications, clinical trials, validation studies, and congress presentations to assess assay performance, clinical validity, clinical utility, and relevance to patient care.
Analyze developments in comprehensive genomic profiling, tissue and liquid biopsy, companion diagnostics, molecular residual disease testing, and emerging early detection approaches.
Compare study designs, patient populations, endpoints, and methodological limitations to determine the strength of evidence supporting diagnostic claims.
Monitor oncology testing guidelines and clinical practice developments that may affect test adoption, evidence requirements, or product positioning.

Market and Competitive Landscape Analysis

Track competitor test launches, product enhancements, regulatory activity, partnerships, pricing, reimbursement, and commercial developments.
Develop competitor and product profiles that compare test capabilities, clinical applications, supporting evidence, sample requirements, turnaround times, and workflow considerations.
Conduct focused market assessments and primary and secondary research to identify competitive threats, unmet needs, and opportunities for differentiation.
Produce monthly intelligence updates, quarterly landscape reviews, dashboards, and targeted analyses that explain the implications of scientific and market developments.

Strategic Insights and Collaboration

Translate complex scientific and business information into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for functional leaders.
Partner with Medical Affairs, R&D, Commercial, and Marketing to assess emerging evidence and support positioning, evidence generation, and launch planning.
Collaborate with Market Access and Business Development on payer coverage trends, reimbursement developments, partnership evaluations, and opportunity assessments.
Support intelligence planning, coverage, and debriefs for major oncology and molecular diagnostics congresses, including ASCO, ESMO, and AMP.

Tools and Processes

Use scientific databases, regulatory resources, market research, analyst reports, and expert interviews to build well-supported intelligence deliverables.
Apply AI tools to improve research and synthesis while verifying source accuracy and protecting confidential information.
Maintain a searchable intelligence repository with clear sourcing, consistent updates, and accessible reporting formats.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, molecular biology, genetics, or a related field.
At least 3 years of relevant experience demonstrating depth through either of the following pathways:

Scientific or clinical experience in oncology and oncology diagnostics, including molecular pathology, tumor genomics, translational research, clinical research, or medical affairs, with demonstrated ability to assess diagnostic evidence and its strategic implications.
Substantial experience focused on oncology diagnostics market analysis, competitive intelligence, equity research, consulting, or a related analyst role, with demonstrated ability to interpret scientific and clinical evidence.
Strong understanding of cancer biology, molecular diagnostic technologies, and the role of testing in treatment selection and disease monitoring.
Ability to critically assess clinical and technical evidence and distinguish established findings from preliminary results and promotional claims.
Experience integrating publications, clinical trial data, company disclosures, market research, and expert input into clear, defensible conclusions.
Strong analytical, writing, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate with scientific and commercial audiences.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, scientific literature searching, and relevant research or data visualization tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and work independently with high integrity and appropriate handling of confidential information.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or clinical discipline, such as an MS, PhD, MD, PharmD or equivalent; an MBA with substantial oncology diagnostics experience is also valuable.
Experience in a molecular diagnostics laboratory, oncology diagnostics company, or research or advisory organization focused on precision oncology.
Familiarity with diagnostic regulatory pathways, payer coverage, reimbursement, and commercial adoption drivers.
Experience conducting expert interviews or developing scientific and competitive congress summaries.

Physical Demands

Ability to travel, including occasional evenings and weekends, as required for congresses and business needs.
Ability to perform typical office activities, including using standard office equipment and handling routine office supplies.

Training

Complete all job-specific, safety, and compliance training assigned based on the responsibilities of the role.

Conditions of Employment:
Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.
